name: specx-cli
description: Set up SpecX in your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, VS Code / Copilot): npx specx-cli@latest init
author: Redoxsoft (https://redoxsoft.com)

scripts.release:patch: npm run release:check && npm version patch && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:check && npm version minor && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm run release:check && npm version major && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:check: node scripts/check-publish.mjs && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
